title.en: Modify the status of the recording feature

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### Queries per second (QPS) limit  
The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to Rate Limiting, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
